svg.title: Exact coverage of 95% intervals for a proportion with n = 20, plotted against the true p. The Wald curve is jagged and falls far below 0.95, and drops off the bottom of the chart (below 0.75) near p = 0 and p = 1. The Wilson curve is jagged around 0.95, dipping to about 0.85 very close to 0 and 1. The Clopper–Pearson curve stays above 0.95 everywhere, mostly near 0.97 to 0.99.
